t: Malta Public Transport to Provide Extra Trips for Nadur Fireworks Display
html:
Malta Public Transport announces that it will be operating two additional evening trips between Mġarr and Nadur in Gozo on Saturday 18 April 2026 to facilitate passenger travel following the fireworks display in Nadur, part of the Malta International Fireworks Festival.

Two extra return trips will be operated from Nadur at 22:45 and 23:15, allowing passengers to travel comfortably after the conclusion of the fireworks display. These supplementary services will complement the regular scheduled network operating in Gozo on the night.

Passengers are also reminded that Routes 303 and 323 will be available for travel from Mġarr to Nadur ahead of the event, providing access for those attending the festivities earlier in the evening, including those travelling from Malta by ferry.

All holders of a personalised Tallinja Card may travel free of charge on day, night and special services. Passengers without a valid card may purchase a ticket on board, at the cost of €2 for normal day journeys, or €3 for special and night services. Both cash and contactless payment methods are accepted.

Further details are available on the Malta Public Transport website and its social media platforms.
